profile.headline: SWE @ Apple | UWaterloo ECE Alumni
profile.summary: Waterloo Computer Engineering alumni, currently employed at Apple. Feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Security Software Engineer
positions.description: Security Engineering and Architecture (SEAR) - Data Protection

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected real-time streaming media features for new hardware and software releases. Continuously optimized power, performance, and memory footprints to ensure FaceTime operates flawlessly across all Apple devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Spearheaded brand new DevOps initiatives on the Camera Module Integrity team from scratch.

positions.title: Application Security and DevOps Developer
positions.description: Contributed to cloud infrastructure, integrated SSO authentication mechanisms, and reduced potential attack vectors of a WiFi based marketing service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to the backend development of an ESG-specialized B2B SaaS solution backed by South Korea's POSCO Group.

positions.title: Broadcast Staff
positions.description: Supported production and broadcasting at Warrior Esports, the University of Waterloo's official Esports organization, by preparing and managing numerous Twitch broadcasts.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Extended and scaled the platform used to scan Internet-facing servers and assets in an effort to detect vulnerabilities on the External Vulnerability Assessment team.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: System Software Developer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Engineered security software solutions in various software components at NVIDIA's Tegra software security team.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Security · Cryptography · C · Linux · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Security Developer
positions.description: Tested, monitored, and developed the security features of the QNX operating system at the security team of BlackBerry QNX.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · C · Linux · Python (Programming Language) · Klocwork · MISRA

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description: Remotely taught students the Math, Physics, and Economics subjects of the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme, an advanced academic programme providing an internationally accepted qualification for entry into higher education.

positions.title: Engineering Research Assistant
positions.description: Directly participated in the research, planning, and implementation of solutions to real-world engineering problems at the Engineering IDEAs Clinic.

volunteerExperiences.description: Exclusively invited as the first student to HP's Expert Program after providing technical advice on HP's user-based support forum. Wrote troubleshooting articles amassing 100K+ views and participated in in-person HP conferences across the US.
Supported aspiring STEM leaders within the Korean Canadian community at UW.
